subject.base_state: README.md contained only the repository title; LICENSE was Apache-2.0
subject.requested_role: Transform allowed traces of already running local processes into useful numeric signals, triggers, and Janus face outputs while minimizing and measuring DemiHead's own load.

engineering_interpretation.foreign_process_as_source: An independently running process remains unchanged while DemiHead reads only allowlisted operating-system or documented public telemetry.
engineering_interpretation.useful_number: A bounded derived signal with a named transform, scale or unit, timestamp, freshness, confidence, version, and provenance.
engineering_interpretation.structuring_chaos: Convert irregular metric samples into lifecycle-safe deltas, bounded windows, normalized signals, quality states, and deterministic triggers.
engineering_interpretation.anti_dispersion: Reduce unstable presentation of noisy measurements through bounded normalization, freshness gates, confidence, and hysteresis; no physical anti-dispersion claim is made.
engineering_interpretation.face: A deterministic projection of one shared signal frame for a declared output purpose and effect scope.
engineering_interpretation.zero_load_boundary: Literal zero overhead is not claimed. Observer CPU, memory, I/O, and loop lag are part of the measured result.

ecosystem_review.inventory_scope: Repository metadata for all repositories accessible through the Hawkar-usls GitHub installation was reviewed; selected Janus repositories received README and policy-level review.

adopted_patterns.pattern: Public maturity, reviewer path, machine-readable status, and explicit claim boundaries.
Observer-first measurement, exact work accounting, and preservation of null or negative outcomes.
Protocol invariants, heartbeat/freshness states, and explicit observer-pressure limits.
Fail-closed admission, provenance, deterministic replay, and refusal to promote finite tests into broad claims.
Portable versioned JSON objects and explicit authority boundaries.
Historical resource-monitoring and adaptive-loop lessons, without importing legacy code or speculative claims.
Optional future graph projection for inspectable signal lineage.
Machine-readable reports, corrections, provenance, and historical preservation without claim promotion.

explicit_exclusions: process injection, hooking, impersonation, or memory scraping
credential, command-line secret, payload, keyboard, screen, clipboard, microphone, or decrypted traffic capture
automatic privilege escalation or control bypass
hidden operation from the machine owner or security tooling
claiming an observed process's computation as DemiHead's own
treating random-looking hashes as useful without a defined transform and consumer
precognition, retrocausality, consciousness, or metaphysical claims
automatic external-process control in the v0.1 contract

repository_foundation.reason_runtime_is_deferred: The observation source, first useful signal, face semantics, and measurable overhead budget must be frozen before implementation.

proposed_architecture.first_vertical_slice: Observe one opt-in Windows process using ordinary process counters; derive CPU, memory, I/O-rate, activity, stability, freshness, and observer-cost signals; emit schema-valid JSON Lines.

rationale: is easier to read and type than Janus_Demi_Head
aligns with Janus-Fundamentum and Janus-Demiurge naming
preserves DemiHead as the distinctive product name
naming_review.reason_not_performed: The owner requested discussion before the repository setting is changed.

recommended_github_metadata.description: Work-in-progress local-first adapter that turns read-only process telemetry into normalized signals and resource-aware triggers for the Janus ecosystem.

open_design_gates.question: Which exact first deployment should be observed: native Windows Storj, Docker Storj, NAS/QNAP Storj, Honeygain, Grass, or a synthetic fixture?
Which first derived number is useful to a downstream consumer: activity, stability, burst, spare-capacity, thermal headroom, or another index?
Are faces output formats, decision roles, separate agents, or all three with explicit authority levels?
What measured CPU, memory, disk, and sampling-lag ceiling makes DemiHead acceptable on the target PC?
Who consumes the first output: a human console, another Janus module, HRain, a local API, or only the meta-registry?
